user.title: Step 1: connect to Zonneburen
user.description: Open the Zonneburen web app, go to **My hub** and create a pairing code. Enter that code here.

data_description.server: Leave this as is, unless your neighbourhood has its own web app.
data_description.code: The code from the web app. Upper or lower case doesn't matter.

sensoren.title: Step 2: your meters
sensoren.description:
Connected as **{adres}**.

Home Assistant searched for you. This is what it measures now:

{gevonden}

Looks right? Just click **Submit**. If it says *export* while you are importing (or *charging* while your battery discharges), tick the matching invert option.

data.wijk_automatisch: Join automatically when the neighbourhood has a surplus
data.bediening: Allow control from the web app

data_description.net: The power from your smart meter, positive when importing. If your meter has import and export separately (like DSMR), pick the import here.
data_description.net_terug: Only fill this in if your meter has export in a separate sensor. Zonneburen then uses import minus export.
data_description.net_omdraaien: Tick this if your meter is positive when exporting.
data_description.zon: What your solar panels produce right now.
data_description.batterij: The power of your home battery, positive when discharging.
data_description.batterij_omdraaien: Tick this if your battery is positive while charging.
data_description.soc: How full the battery is, in percent.
data_description.verbruik: You can leave this empty: Zonneburen then works it out itself.
data_description.wijk_automatisch: When the neighbourhood has power to spare, Home Assistant switches on your chosen devices by itself. Off: you get a notification to confirm first.
data_description.bediening: Lets you switch devices in Home Assistant on and off from the web app.

apparaten.title: Step 3: devices
apparaten.description:
Zonneburen can switch these devices on when the neighbourhood has power to spare, or when the energy plan picks the cheapest moment. Tick what may take part.

Nothing changes about how they are set now. With neighbourhood power a heat pump goes 1 degree up and a water heater 10 degrees. You can change this later in the web app under **Devices**.

batterij.title: Step 4: home battery
batterij.description:
{uitleg}

Turn this on and your battery charges when power is cheap and discharges when it is expensive, following the energy plan from the web app. In the web app set **Energy plan** to **Control**. You can always turn it off again with the *Carry out energy plan* switch.

data.ems_aan: Yes, let Zonneburen control my battery

details.name: Details (filled in automatically)
details.description: Only needed if the battery was not recognised correctly.

data.ems_ontlaad: Discharge power (only with a separate number)

data_description.ems_vermogen: The number (W) your battery integration uses to set the power. Positive means discharging, unless you flip it below.
data_description.ems_ontlaad: If your battery has separate numbers for charging and discharging (like Marstek), pick the discharge number here and the charge number above.
data_description.ems_netdoel: Tick this if the number sets the desired power on the grid, like the grid setpoint of a Victron ESS.
data_description.ems_modus: A select or switch that first puts the battery in external control. You pick the modes in the next step.
data_description.ems_richting: A select with options for charging, discharging and stopping.
data_description.ems_max_laad_w: In watts. Empty or 0: the maximum from the plan.
data_description.ems_max_ontlaad_w: In watts. Empty or 0: the maximum from the plan.
data_description.ems_zekering_a: In amps. The battery charges less hard as soon as a phase gets close to this value.

data_description.ems_profiel: With a power in W (most batteries), or with the time-of-use programs of a Deye or Sunsynk.

standen.title: Battery modes
standen.description: Zonneburen already picked the modes. If they look right, click **Submit**.

data_description.ems_modus_terug: The mode in which the battery manages itself again.

deye.title: Deye / Sunsynk: time-of-use programs

data.ems_tou_max_pct: Grid charging at most up to
data.ems_tou_min_pct: Minimum if the inverter reports none

data_description.ems_tou_laden: The six Program 1-6 Charging selects. When charging Zonneburen sets them to Grid, otherwise to Disabled.
data_description.ems_tou_soc: The six Program 1-6 SOC numbers: the target when charging, the minimum when holding or in self-consumption.
data_description.ems_tou_stroom: Zonneburen derives the charging current from the planned power and the battery voltage.
data_description.ems_tou_max_pct: How full the battery may be charged from the grid. Default 90 %.
data_description.ems_tou_min_pct: Used when no minimum of the inverter is chosen. Default 20 %.
data_description.ems_zekering_a: When a phase gets close to the fuse, the battery charges more slowly.
data_description.ems_tou_werkmodus: Zonneburen sets it to Zero Export To CT (self-consumption on the meter), and only to Export First when exporting.
data_description.ems_tou_max_laad_a: Only set to 0 in standby; otherwise your own value stays.
data_description.ems_tou_max_export: Only used when battery export is allowed.
data_description.ems_tou_terugleveren: Off by default. On: at high prices the battery may export (Export First).
data_description.ems_tou_fasen: For the main fuse: within 2 A of the fuse the battery charges 10 A less.

error.code_onbekend: This code is unknown or expired. Create a new one in the web app.
error.niet_toegestaan: The server refuses this pairing. Ask your neighbourhood board for help.
error.te_vaak: Too many attempts. Try again in fifteen minutes.
error.niet_bereikbaar: The web app cannot be reached. Check the address and your internet connection.
error.geen_https: The address must start with https://.
error.geen_vermogen: Under Details, pick the number that controls your battery.
error.geen_programmas: Choose at least the charging selects and the state-of-charge numbers of the programs.

deye_schrijven.title: Zonneburen cannot set the time-of-use programs of your inverter
deye_schrijven.description:
Setting the time-of-use programs of your Deye or Sunsynk failed three times in a row. Last error: {fout}

Check that the inverter is reachable (the Solarman integration) and that the chosen entities still exist, under Zonneburen → Configure → Home battery. This notice disappears by itself once it works again.
